# MP Doors

> Composite and fiberglass entry and patio doors, made in the USA since 2004 and sold through The Home Depot. Every door is built on a 100% waterproof composite frame with a six sided HydroShield seal, and is ENERGY STAR certified across all four United States climate zones.

Shipped on the evidence in spec file 04: no AI crawler is blocked, and this file is a convenience rather than a coverage claim.

## Collection

- [Fiberglass Entry Doors](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/): Browse all 10 MP Doors fiberglass front door styles on waterproof composite frames. Every page lists the actual unit size and frame depth. At The Home Depot.
- [Composite Patio Doors](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/patio-doors/): Compare MP Doors composite patio doors: gliding sliding models, hinged French pairs and an HVHZ impact rated door. 100% waterproof. At The Home Depot.
- [Gliding Patio Doors](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/patio-doors/gliding/): MP Doors gliding patio doors: composite sliders on stainless steel tandem rollers, in Full Lite and 3/4 Lite. Low-E glass, DP50 rated. At The Home Depot.
- [Hinged and French Patio Doors](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/patio-doors/hinged/): MP Doors hinged French patio doors in Full Lite, 3/4 Lite and HVHZ impact. Both panels open on ball-bearing hinges, inswing or outswing. At The Home Depot.

## Entry doors

- [3/4 Lite Entry Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/3-4-lite/): MP Doors 3/4 Lite entry door: Savana or Scotia decorative glass in Medium Oak or Light Oak, on a 100% waterproof composite frame. At The Home Depot.
- [3/4 Oval Lite Entry Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/3-4-oval-lite/): MP Doors 3/4 Oval Lite entry door: curb appeal from five oval glass patterns including Andaman with Brass, in Medium Oak or Light Oak. At The Home Depot.
- [3 Lite Entry Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/3-lite/): MP Doors 3 Lite entry door: three broad horizontal lites in a mid-century modern profile, in White or Black. Four glass options at The Home Depot.
- [4 Lite Entry Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/4-lite/): MP Doors 4 Lite entry door: four horizontal lites in three finishes, White, Black or Smooth Latte. WaterWave or Frost glass. At The Home Depot.
- [Contemporary Teak Entry Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/contemporary-teak/): MP Doors Contemporary Teak entry door: modern minimalism with the warmth of natural wood, in Medium Oak or Light Oak composite. At The Home Depot.
- [Craftsman Entry Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/craftsman/): MP Doors Craftsman entry door: straight edge panel and glazing bead, four finishes, five glass options, 1, 3 and 6 Lite SDL layouts. At The Home Depot.
- [Full Lite Entry Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/full-lite/): MP Doors Full Lite entry door: a full glass panel in White composite with Savana or Scotia decorative glass, in 32 in. and 36 in. widths. At The Home Depot.
- [1/2 Lite Entry Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/half-lite/): MP Doors 1/2 Lite entry door: half glass in Savana, Scotia or blinds, 32 and 36 in. widths. A 36 in. door is 37-3/8 in. overall. At The Home Depot.
- [Modern Full Lite Entry Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/modern-full-lite/): MP Doors Modern Full Lite entry door: full glass in White or Black composite with Frost, Low-E, Clear or blinds between glass. At The Home Depot.
- [Narrow Lite Entry Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/entry-doors/narrow-lite/): MP Doors Narrow Lite entry door: a slim vertical insert in WaterWave, Radiant or Frost glass. Daylight without losing privacy. At The Home Depot.

## Patio doors

- [2 Panel Gliding Patio Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/patio-doors/gliding/2-panel/): MP Doors 2 Panel gliding patio door: a full glass composite sliding door, DP50 rated with Low-E standard and ENERGY STAR in all four zones. At The Home Depot.
- [3/4 Lite Gliding Patio Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/patio-doors/gliding/3-4-lite/): MP Doors 3/4 Lite gliding patio door: a composite slider in 60 x 80 and 72 x 80, glass over a solid lower rail, on stainless rollers. At The Home Depot.
- [Full Lite Hinged Patio Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/patio-doors/hinged/full-lite/): MP Doors Full Lite hinged French patio door: full glass, both panels open on ball-bearing hinges, inswing or outswing, PG55 outswing. At The Home Depot.
- [3/4 Lite Hinged Patio Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/patio-doors/hinged/3-4-lite/): MP Doors 3/4 Lite hinged patio door: glass over a solid lower panel, in two sizes, inswing or outswing, with Clear, SDL or GBG glass. At The Home Depot.
- [HVHZ Impact Patio Door](https://umarucreative.github.io/MPDoors-Final-20260828/patio-doors/hinged/impact-full-lite/): MP Doors HVHZ impact hinged patio door: Florida approval FL-29714.2, impact Low-E glass, DP50 rated, outswing only. For hurricane zones, at The Home Depot.
